# Updating a Mobile App

## Mobile App Update

Your apps should update automatically if you have automatic updates enabled on your mobile device's preferences. To activate automatic updates or to update our app manually, you can take the following steps.

#### In This Article

- [iOS Instructions](https://wellinks.helpscoutdocs.com/article/86-updating-a-mobile-app#iOS-Instructions-wbTMa)
- [Android Instructions](https://wellinks.helpscoutdocs.com/article/86-updating-a-mobile-app#Android-Instructions-5yq4g)

* * *

## iOS Instructions

#### Enable All Automatic Updates

1. Go to your phone's Settings > App Store
2. Under Automatic Downloads, tap the switch for App Updates. You may not be able to enable this feature if you're in Low Battery Mode.
3. Enabling App Updates will allow all apps on your phone to update automatically.

If you already have Automatic Downloads turned on, you should see a yellow-orange dot on your Wellinks app icon when looking at your iPhone apps screen.

#### Update Manually

If you do not want to enable automatic updates for all apps on your phone, you can update the Wellinks app manually.

1. Open the App Store app.
2. Click the Search tab, and type in Wellinks.
3. Click on Update.

* * *

## Android Instructions

#### Enable All Automatic Updates

1. Open the Google Play Store app Google Play.
2. At the top right, tap the profile icon.
3. Tap Settings and then Network Preferences and then Auto-update apps.
4. Select an option:
1. Over any network to update apps using either Wi-Fi or mobile data.
2. Over Wi-Fi only to update apps only when connected to Wi-Fi.

Note: If an account on your device has a sign-in error, apps may not update automatically.

#### Update Manually

1. Open the Google Play Store app
2. At the top right, tap the profile icon.
3. Tap Manage apps & device. The Wellinks apps will be labeled with "Update available."
4. Tap Update.
